Corrected KV 143/200 failure and original failed controller receipts are preserved. Cost uses a retrospective first-start/last-success envelope, milliseconds different from the retained original benchmark duration. Each arm has 200 enclosed requests, 282,265 input and 51,200 output tokens; all four reserved cards count. Equal-fee resource coefficient falls 22.601951%, but card 4/5 utilization does not improve; cards 6/7 are zero. Utilization is left-held at sample-command end and clipped to the same interval; maximum gaps are 1.068/1.250 seconds (control/B1). This is a retrospective estimate. Fee P/month-days D and new/cache-hit input split remain unbound. The control is 0.28.1/0.25.1rc2, not fixed B0: no monetary acceptance. The chart's 4 CNY/card-hour display assumption is not a documented all-in fee for this run. SWE windows use completion time, actual input+output tokens and nearest-rank quantiles; original interpolated quantiles remain separate. Full-hour rows are below, with phase windows in the JSON. Mixed contexts are not a controlled 4K/16K pair, and E2E is not TTFT/TPOT. Normal-return extracts do not establish absence of OOM, deadlock, unexpected exits or silent truncation across all tasks.
